source.scope: Exact BroadcastName 2026 British Chess Championships: Championship, 2026.08.01 through 2026.08.09, main rounds 1 through 9, legal result-bearing complete games; broadcast-visible coverage only

source_preseal_gate.required: A reachable Git commit on WhoSia/C3X with author and committer both WhoSia must contain this contract and the exact candidate manifest bytes before the first new native run.
source_preseal_gate.candidate_manifest_status_field: CANDIDATE_NOT_HUMAN_PRESEALED is the precommit state; the verified Git commit is the human seal and must be recorded separately.

stage_A_untreated.ordering: source rank, repeat 1 then 2, arms in listed order
stage_A_untreated.equivalence: For each of 64 paired cases require exact chronological retained UCI depth/seldepth/multipv/score/bounds/WDL/nodes/PV projection and final bestmove/ponder equality, ORIGINAL vs ACTIVE_SHAM and ACTIVE_SHAM vs OBSERVER_SHAM. Exclude only time/nps/hashfull/tbhits from equivalence; preserve them as diagnostics.
stage_A_untreated.forecast_boundary: After Stage A, freeze literal response-informed candidate/rival forecasts, intervention eligibility and Stage A receipt with a second WhoSia author+committer Git commit before Stage B. No new positions or response-dependent sample replacement.

stage_B_treatment.condition: Only after Stage A exact equivalence PASS and second human Git forecast commit.
stage_B_treatment.trace_authority: Retain all emitted writer/reader/source/SEE records. Existing first-contact P6 event lacks a complete same-run writer-reader-to-SEE-to-root link; mark natural mediation NOT_OBSERVED unless separately demonstrated by exact source lineage.

claim_ceiling.independent_scope: One new tournament section and 32 legal games; no event-transport inference without a second event.
claim_ceiling.tt_see_natural_mediation: HOLD unless same-run source lineage and an independent SEE intervention identify it.
